data.content_ref: inline:The isolated artifact abstracts the foundation's specific mean-principle derivation into a general covering principle: for any constraint pair (sum S, structure 'three consecutive even integers'), the solution is the unique triple satisfying both constraints simultaneously. It abstracts SRC_012's empiric-style verification and SRC_010's mean derivation into a single satisficing framework. This abstraction is refuted if the foundation's concrete derivation cannot be recovered by instantiating S=138 and structure=consecutive-even, or if some other triple also satisfies both constraints simultaneously (which would destroy uniqueness and hence the covering claim).
